text:
anna: Heads-up — hit a reproducible multi-node stall while scaling TP across 4 nodes (tp=8, 32 ranks). Happens when we switch model variant mid-run and KV cache sync kicks in. Reproducer attached below.

anna: Repro command:
```
./infra/run_infer.sh --nodes 4 --ranks-per-node 8 --model redwood-v2-11b --batch-size 1 --switch-after-steps 120 --log-level debug
```

anna: Short logs (rank 5):
```
[2026-03-12 14:02:10] rank=5 INFO selected_kernel=int8_gemm_fast layer=11
[2026-03-12 14:02:12] rank=5 WARN kvcache: waiting for peer kv-lock (timeout=2000ms)
[2026-03-12 14:02:15] rank=5 ERROR allreduce: timeout waiting for NCCL op, op=allreduce_kv_meta
[2026-03-12 14:02:15] rank=5 ERROR rendezvous: stuck waiting on 3/32 peers
```

sam: Oof. Did this start after the kernel-selector perf change last week? :thinking:

dmitri: Could be NCCL timeouts or a race in KV cache draining code. Two quick checks: 1) compare nccl-tests bandwidth between nodes; 2) try bumping NCCL_TIMEOUT and enabling async error handling.

maya: We did flip the batching heuristic on 2026-03-10 — small-batch path now disables prefetch for safety. That might increase KV cache churn when a model switch happens.

lee: I saw a similar hang in a canary a month ago — turned out to be the KV cache migration path hitting an allreduce between kernel selection and kv metadata sync. Rolling kernel-selector back prevented the deadlock.

sam: Can you reproduce with a single-node multi-gpu run? If it's purely inter-node nccl, single-node might be fine. If it repros single-node, it's kernel/kv logic rather than network.

anna: Single-node (8 GPUs) is flaky but doesn't hang. Multi-node is 100% within ~30s after switch. So network allreduce seems involved.

dmitri: Share strace/nccl debug output. Also check GPU driver mismatch across nodes — silent hangs can come from that.

anna: Collected traces: attached timeline snippet (nvtx/nvprof): compute windows overlap most allreduce windows, but there's a long idle (~6s) where ranks wait for kv sync. Looks like an ordering inversion: one rank enters allreduce late and others block.

maya: That ordering inversion could be from our kernel selector doing a sync on the default stream when picking a fallback kernel. If kernel selection calls cudaDeviceSynchronize indirectly, it will break NCCL async progress ordering.

sam: Good call. Search for any cudaDeviceSynchronize or explicit stream sync in the selector. Also check if we changed the default stream semantics in recent kernel patches.

anna: Quick grep shows one path where the selector calls cudaMemcpy (host) for small-weight reshapes — that will sync. Patch referenced: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/changes/PR-2247

lee: If that's the path, the timeline matches: rank A doing host copy -> implicit sync -> enters allreduce late -> others sit in nccl barrier. That explains cross-node hang.

dmitri: Workaround: set REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEBUG=1 to force selector to choose precompiled kernels without the host-reshape path. Also try REDWOOD_BATCH_HEUR=legacy to avoid cache migration during switch.

anna: Trying workaround now. Env snippet I'm using:
```
export REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEBUG=1
export REDWOOD_BATCH_HEUR=legacy
export NCCL_TIMEOUT=600
```

deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-10 08:12 rolled out -> runtime v2.3.1 (kernel-selector changes included)

maya: If workaround stops the hang, we should hotfix the selector to avoid host-sync on the hot path. Also add a per-rank pre-switch fence check to detect late entrants.

sam: For debug traces, run with NCCL_DEBUG=INFO and REDWOOD_KVCACHE_LOG=trace; produce per-rank logs and attach tarball.

anna: Workaround results: with REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEBUG=1 + legacy batching, multi-node run completed 500 steps without hang. With default env it hangs ~30s. So selector-induced sync is the leading hypothesis.

dmitri: Next steps from my side: instrument selector code to avoid host copies (use device-to-device reshape kernels) and add a metric for selector-induced syncs. I'll open PR and a canary.

maya: I'll add a guard in batching heuristic to postpone KV cache migration during active allreduces; also add a canary test in the perf harness for model-switch scenarios.

lee: Add a temporary mitigation in the orchestrator: if node sees kv-sync stall >2s, have it fallback the switching node to older model variant to avoid cluster-wide stall.

anna: Action list:
- dmitri: PR to remove host-sync path in selector (in progress)
- maya: batching heuristic guard and perf test
- sam: run nccl-tests across nodes and verify driver parity
- anna: gather full nvprof/nccl traces and upload to the incident ticket

anna: I'll paste repro artifacts in the ticket once uploaded. Thanks all :thumbsup!
